spm 0.1.0+e631a407653c6abfed1cf8df2d4391b0f57095ab
spm (Skills Package Manager) — a CLI, interactive REPL, and MCP server that installs AI agent skills from Git catalogs into Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, Cursor, Cline, Devin, Aider, and Open Interpreter.
Commands
Command               Description                                            
catalog ...           List configured skill catalogs and their sync status   
install <skillName>   Install a skill into every detected agent (project     
                      and/or global scope)                                   
list                  List all skills across synced catalogs with their      
                      install status                                         
uninstall <skillName> Remove a skill from every agent it was deployed to     
update                Sync the skill's catalog and re-install it if a newer  
                      version exists                                         

Global Options
Name                    Description                                          
--help                  Show help for current scope or command.              
--interactive           Force interactive mode.                              
--no-interactive        Prevent interactive mode.                            
--no-logo               Disable banner rendering.                            
--output:<format>       Set output format (for example human, json, yaml,    
                        xml, markdown).                                      
--human                 Select standard text output.                         
--answer:<name>[=value] Provide prompt answers in non-interactive execution. 

Global Commands
Name        Description                                              
help [path] Show help for current path or a specific path. Aliases: ?
..          Go up one level in interactive mode.                     
exit        Leave interactive mode.
